question: Why did the p95 latency go up on 04 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: Config change to reduce db.pool_size from 50 to 5, leading to connection pool exhaustion.
why_chain: The config change reduced the connection pool size, causing more connections to be exhausted.
With fewer connections available, the pool could not handle the increased load, leading to exhaustion.
This exhaustion resulted in the warning messages observed in the logs.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Deployment of a new release or version caused the change.
ruled_out.reason: No evidence of a new release or version deployment was found.

ruled_out.hypothesis: External dependency failure caused the change.
ruled_out.reason: No evidence of an external service failure or slowdown was found.
No evidence of network or capacity issues was found.
No evidence of bad or unusual input data was found.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Increased request volume for service checkout.
ruled_out.reason: It rests on a change that is too early, or in a different service/region, to explain a sudden change here.

evidence.summary: P95 latency for service checkout rose from 220 ms to 638 ms (+190%), with a change point at 2026-03-04T04:55:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service checkout: 3 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.01).
At the same time, request volume for service checkout stayed about the same (819 per 5 min before, 940 per 5 min after, +15%).
At the same time, error rate for service checkout rose (0.46% before, 0.70% after, +51%).
Changed checkout db.pool_size from 50 to 5 (all regions) (checkout; 1 min before the change; record R009; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
checkout: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (checkout, us-east; 2 min after the change; record R010; fit: describes a symptom, not a change)
checkout: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (checkout, eu-west; 3 min after the change; record R011; fit: describes a symptom, not a change)
p95 latency above SLO on checkout (checkout; 15 min after the change; record R013; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
checkout: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (checkout, ap-south; 7 min after the change; record R012; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)

reasons: ✓ A change event (config_changes) lines up in time (1 min before the change).
✓ 4 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Roll back the config change to 50 pool size and monitor the system.
Implement a connection pool monitoring and alerting system to detect exhaustion early.
Optimize the database queries to reduce the number of connections needed.
